author: musho7-dev
subject: Add 3 maps (Jungle Hills, Neon City, Volcano Ridge); make runs harder
body:
Maps:
- Jungle Hills (300): green hills with trees along the road
- Neon City (600): night skyline with lit windows and antennas, asphalt
  road with yellow lane dashes and street lamps; smooth and grippy
- Volcano Ridge (1500): red sky, sharp peaks, rocks, glowing lava layer
- Garage picture tiles for each; daily run picks from all 6 maps

Difficulty (it had become too easy after the suspension fix):
- Hills keep growing after 200 m, up to 1.8x by about 650 m
- Fuel cans get rarer the further you drive
- Upgrades a little weaker per level (engine, tires, shocks, tank)
- Measured with full-gas self-test: no-upgrade cars now end around
  510 m (out of fuel); fast maxed cars need careful driving

Self-test: help/pause checks only with "helptest"; "noupg"/"maxupg"
set the car's upgrades; runs up to 75 s.
